title: Tuck Johnson band repertoire and leaving in 1927
summary: The band played ragtime much like Albert's; he stayed 1924 to late 1927 and returned home to a sick wife.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

Yeah. 24 to 28. Did any more guys from New Orleans join the band in that time? No, I'm mistaken, it wasn't 28. It was the last of 27. Because she was in the hospital and I had to come home. And I was the last 27 when I came back.
You came back to New Orleans? Yeah. Which did you call her, here or on her lands? Both of them.
